data.summary: Expand by multiplying every term; factorise by extracting common factors or recognising identities. Only like terms can be combined.
key_concepts: Only like terms can be added or subtracted (e.g. 2x + 3x = 5x)
Expand by multiplying the outside term (or each term) through every term in the bracket
Factorisation reverses expansion: take out the HCF, use identities, grouping, or the cross method

formulas.label: Perfect square and difference of squares
formulas.note: Spot these before using the general rainbow/FOIL method.

common_mistakes.mistake: Combining unlike terms such as 3x and 5.
common_mistakes.fix: Only like terms (same letters and powers) can be added or subtracted.

exam_tips: Expand your factorised answer mentally to check it.
Completely usually means take out a common factor and then factorise further.
